# Forms

Fields, inputs, selection controls, sliders and uploads.

[Field](#field) · [Input](#input) · [Select](#select) · [Checkbox, RadioGroup, Switch](#checkbox-radiogroup-switch) · [Slider](#slider) · [OtpInput](#otpinput) · [PasswordStrength](#passwordstrength) · [Dropzone, PhotoPicker](#dropzone-photopicker)

### Field

Wraps a control with its label, hint and error message, and wires the ids so screen readers read them together.

```ts
import { Field, useFieldProps } from '@/kit/components/forms/Field'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `ReactNode` |  | Visible label, tied to the control with `htmlFor`. |
| `hint` | `ReactNode` |  | Help text under the control. Hidden while there is an error. |
| `error` | `string` |  | Error message. Sets `aria-invalid` on the control and is announced. |
| `optional` | `boolean` |  | Shows an "Optional" note next to the label. |
| `children` *(required)* | `ReactNode` |  | The control: any kit input, Select, DatePicker … |

```tsx
<Field label="Email" hint="We never share it." error={errors.email}>
  <Input type="email" value={email} onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)} />
</Field>
```

- Kit controls read the surrounding Field through `useFieldProps()` (exported from the same file) and pick up their `id`, `aria-describedby` and `aria-invalid` automatically. Use it in your own controls.

### Input

A single-line text box with optional icon and trailing content. TextField, PasswordField, Textarea and SearchInput build on it.

```ts
import { Input, TextField, PasswordField, Textarea, SearchInput } from '@/kit/components/forms/Field'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Control height. |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` |  | Icon inside the box on the left. |
| `affix` | `ReactNode` |  | Content inside the box on the right, such as a button or shortcut. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` |  | TextField, PasswordField: label, with `hint`, `error` and `optional` as on Field. |
| `value` *(required)* | `string` |  | SearchInput: current text. |
| `onValueChange` *(required)* | `(value: string) => void` |  | SearchInput: called with the new text. |
| `shortcut` | `string` |  | SearchInput: key hint shown while the box is empty, e.g. "/". |

```tsx
<TextField label="Email" type="email" icon={<Mail />} value={email} onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)} />
<PasswordField value={pw} onChange={(e) => setPw(e.target.value)} />
<SearchInput value={q} onValueChange={setQ} shortcut="/" placeholder="Search assets" />
```

- Every native input attribute is passed through, and refs are forwarded.
- PasswordField has a show/hide button; its label and button text follow the site locale (English or Turkish). SearchInput has a clear button once there is text.

### Select

A keyboard-friendly dropdown with optional search and groups.

```ts
import { Select } from '@/kit/components/forms/Select'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` *(required)* | `SelectOption<T>[]` |  | Choices: `{ value, label, description?, icon?, disabled?, group? }`. Options with the same `group` are listed under one heading. |
| `value` *(required)* | `T \| null` |  | Selected value, or null for none. |
| `onChange` *(required)* | `(value: T) => void` |  | Called with the chosen value. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `'Select…'` | Shown when nothing is selected. |
| `searchable` | `boolean` |  | Adds a search box at the top of the list. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Disables the control. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` |  | Accessible name when not inside a Field. |

```tsx
<Select value={country} onChange={setCountry} searchable options={[{ value: 'tr', label: 'Türkiye' }, { value: 'us', label: 'United States' }]} />
```

- ↑ ↓ Home End move, Enter selects, Esc closes; typing jumps to a matching option.
- Do not nest it inside a Popover: its list is a separate floating layer.

### Checkbox, RadioGroup, Switch

Selection controls with built-in labels and descriptions.

```ts
import { Checkbox, RadioGroup, Switch } from '@/kit/components/forms/Controls'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `checked` *(required)* | `boolean` |  | Checkbox, Switch: current state. |
| `onChange` *(required)* | `(checked: boolean) => void` |  | Checkbox, Switch: called with the new state. RadioGroup passes the new value instead. |
| `label` *(required)* | `ReactNode` |  | Checkbox, Switch: label. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` |  | Smaller text under the label. |
| `indeterminate` | `boolean` |  | Checkbox: mixed state. |
| `legend` *(required)* | `string` |  | RadioGroup: accessible group name (not shown). |
| `options` *(required)* | `RadioOption<T>[]` |  | RadioGroup: `{ value, label, description?, price?, disabled? }`. |
| `cards` | `boolean` |  | RadioGroup: bordered cards instead of plain radios. |

```tsx
<Checkbox checked={agree} onChange={setAgree} label="I agree to the terms" />
<Switch checked={alerts} onChange={setAlerts} label="Price alerts" description="Notify me about big moves." />
<RadioGroup cards legend="Plan" value={plan} onChange={setPlan} options={[{ value: 'plus', label: 'Plus', price: '$7 / mo' }]} />
```

- Switch renders `role="switch"`; RadioGroup renders a `fieldset` with a hidden legend.

### Slider

A range input with the filled track and a live value readout.

```ts
import { Slider } from '@/kit/components/forms/Slider'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` *(required)* | `string` |  | Label, also the accessible name. |
| `value` *(required)* | `number` |  | Current value. |
| `onChange` *(required)* | `(value: number) => void` |  | Called with the new value. |
| `min` | `number` | `0` | Lower bound. |
| `max` | `number` | `100` | Upper bound. |
| `step` | `number` | `1` | Increment. |
| `format` | `(value: number) => string` |  | How the value is shown, e.g. `(v) => v + "%"`. |
| `ticks` | `string[]` |  | Small labels under the track. |

```tsx
<Slider label="Risk appetite" value={risk} onChange={setRisk} format={(v) => v + ' / 100'} ticks={['Calm', 'Bold']} />
```

### OtpInput

One box per digit for verification codes, with paste support.

```ts
import { OtpInput } from '@/kit/components/forms/OtpInput'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` *(required)* | `string` |  | The digits entered so far. |
| `onChange` *(required)* | `(value: string) => void` |  | Called on every change. |
| `length` | `number` | `6` | Number of digits. |
| `onComplete` | `(value: string) => void` |  | Called once all digits are entered. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` |  | Marks the boxes invalid. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | `'Verification code'` | Accessible group name. |

```tsx
<OtpInput value={code} onChange={setCode} onComplete={verify} invalid={wrong} />
```

- Backspace and arrow keys move between boxes; pasting a code fills all of them; `autocomplete="one-time-code"` is set on the first box.

### PasswordStrength

A four-segment strength meter with a checklist of rules. `passwordRules` and `passwordScore` are exported for your own validation.

```ts
import { PasswordStrength } from '@/kit/components/forms/PasswordStrength'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `password` *(required)* | `string` |  | The password to evaluate. |

```tsx
<PasswordStrength password={password} />
const ok = passwordScore(password) >= 3
```

### Dropzone, PhotoPicker

File upload by drag and drop or click, with thumbnails; and a round profile-photo picker.

```ts
import { Dropzone, PhotoPicker } from '@/kit/components/forms/Dropzone'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` *(required)* | `File[]` |  | Dropzone: the chosen files. PhotoPicker takes `File \| null`. |
| `onChange` *(required)* | `(files: File[]) => void` |  | Called with the new list. |
| `accept` | `string` | `'image/*'` | Dropzone: accepted MIME types, e.g. `image/*`. |
| `multiple` | `boolean` | `true` | Dropzone: allow several files. |
| `maxMb` | `number` | `5` | Largest file size in MB. |
| `maxFiles` | `number` | `8` | Dropzone: most files kept. |
| `title` | `string` |  | Dropzone: headline text. |
| `hint` | `string` |  | Dropzone: small text under the headline. |

```tsx
<Dropzone value={files} onChange={setFiles} maxFiles={4} />
<PhotoPicker value={photo} onChange={setPhoto} />
```

- Rejected files show an inline error naming the file. Nothing is uploaded; handle the `File` objects yourself.
